items.title: 6.3 Applications and Implications of Cloud Computing (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Yeh hissa cloud computing ke aham istemal (applications) dekhta hai aur us ke asraat (implications, yani is ke saath aane wale masail aur zimmedariyan) par baat karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Cloud computing ke teen istemal aur do asraat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Istemal: data storage; web hosting aur content delivery; machine learning aur AI. Asraat: data security, scalability aur resource management, cost (kharcha), compliance (qawaneen ki pabandi); in mein se koi do.

items: 6.3.1: cloud ke istemal; 6.3.2: cloud ke asraat.
